core_obligations: Statement (lines 553-556): Q proves (num n + num m) = num(n+m).
Base case m = 0 (proof lines 558-560): Q_4 directly.
Inductive step (lines 560-568): numeral bookkeeping (num(m+1) = num m', num(n+m+1) = num(n+m)'), then Q_5 plus the induction hypothesis compose to the claim.
proof_roadmap: Unfold the numerals at m+1 and apply Q_5.
Compose with the induction hypothesis for num(n+m).
difficulty_reason: Numeral-addition lemma (statement 553-556, proof 558-568): base and step both carried as short axiom chains. H2.
